item.title: FedEx to sponsor extended MLK free weekend at Two Mississippi Museums
item.description: FedEx will sponsor free admission to the Two Mississippi Museums during an extended observance of the Martin Luther King Jr. holiday from Jan. 17–20. Events will include the MLK Night of Culture and National Day of Racial Healing programs. The post FedEx to sponsor extended MLK free weekend at Two Mississippi Museums appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Seeing Eudora Welty through a different lens
item.description: Eudora Welty is best known as one of Mississippi’s most celebrated writers, but long before her stories found their way into classrooms and anthologies, Welty was traveling the state with a camera, quietly documenting everyday life. item.title: Luigi Mangione’s federal death penalty trial could start before the end of the year
item.description: Luigi Mangione’s federal death penalty trial in the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson could begin before the end of the year, a judge said Friday while weighing a defense bid to bar the government from making it a capital case. The post Luigi Mangione’s federal death penalty trial could start before the end of the year appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Law enforcement reveals details of a shooting spree spanning three houses that left six dead
item.description: Daricka Moore, a 24-year-old male, was booked on first-degree murder charges, Clay County Sheriff Eddie Scott said at a Saturday press conference. Moore was booked at 3:25 a.m. Saturday, after allegedly killing six people at three different homes. The post Law enforcement reveals details of a shooting spree spanning three houses that left six dead appeared first on The Dispatch.
